goal_deadline.single_allocation_end: ends current capsule only; legitimate successor may continue within Goal

collection.wave_B_release: Wave A terminals reconciled or explicitly unstarted/paused; causal TRAIN repair where needed, static geometry and resource binding valid; does not require all cells successful or N2.
collection.old_TRAIN240: separate original population, only genuinely unstarted and allowed conditions may continue, no old STOP rerun or budget transfer
collection.pause_rule: Two consecutive failures with same phase/contact-body mechanism pause that cell/version; all other failure types retain their own mechanism; fatal control error stops affected pool.

geometry.object_shift: red=c-d/2; blue=c+d/2 in original red-to-blue orthonormal basis
geometry.near_duplicate_check: within family, both objects position distance <=0.002m and SO3 angle <=2degrees means near duplicate, independent of reset/task; check all protected historical and newly compiled scene identities without TEST outcomes
geometry.field_rng: SHA256 UTF8(goal|scene_id|decimal_scene_seed|decimal_candidate_index|field); first8bytes unsigned big-endian /2**64, affine-map field range; indices0..63; no rounding

parallel.implementation: separate OS process trees and world-scoped native contracts; no engine upgrade or shared mutable controller state

resources.core_teacher_cpu: disjoint real available cpusets; bind complete process trees; freeze WBC/internal thread configuration
resources.core_eval: original RTX4080S backend, actual GPU UUID and env binding, canonical N1, exclusive finite DEV6 block by default
resources.core_background: bounded existing user service; no laptop requirement; no new cluster CPU-only PBS watchers
resources.H200: continue original MAIN20K training; no new training budget or new cross-device diagnostic jobs
resources.disk_rule: original capacity gate plus aggregate in-flight and next seal temporary write reserve
resources.ram_rule: measure full-episode peak/cgroup high water, reserve all admitted workers globally; do not multiply single-worker free-memory checks
resources.renderer: existing renderer/version/resolution/capture timing; isolated per-world current context
resources.on_backpressure: pause new dispatch; preserve capture and command identity; no frame dropping

core_eval.qualification_budget_definition: 336 regular attempts plus at most48 evidence-driven repair attempts shared by the whole Goal, additional to old paid diagnostics; every real generation intent including failed/incomplete attempts counts
core_eval.initial_native: first original DEV6 per phase0 and MAIN2K; up to12 original requests, not new duplicate population

data_admission.complete_positive: original task plus mobile success, no technical failure or STOP, original G7 and observed RGB/H40/P10 provenance
data_admission.writer: per-world immutable episode; one append-only global catalog owner
data_admission.snapshot: 4 new admitted episodes or6hours or role closure; immutable SHA manifest; no snapshot without new members

training_integration.already_crossed_boundary: do not rollback; adopt only at next unpassed boundary
training_integration.data_missing: continue prior sealed data; record NO_NEW_DATA_CONTINUE
training_integration.control: existing once-only2000-update matched control at first actual adoption; no extra control or main replay
training_integration.late_after_15K: seal and retain data; do not silently append another switch or20K training lineage

new_native_budget.student_DEV_CONF: remain in original endpoint populations and budgets; no added scientific native condition

operational_stop: earliest finite deadline or role cap
STOP_after_nonzero or world cross-talk or corrupt provenance => stop affected pool
resource reserve cannot cover new work => no new dispatch, bounded drain
unknown submit outcome => reconcile original identity, never blind duplicate
same TRAIN failure mechanism => pause only affected cell/version
N2/N4 quality/value failure => fall back to qualified lower concurrency; independent training and allowed N1 continue
